model.name: Blue Brain Project NMC channel set in a single soma compartment (Soma_AllNML2)
model.citation: Markram H, Muller E, Ramaswamy S, Reimann MW, et al. (2015). Reconstruction and Simulation of Neocortical Microcircuitry. Cell 163(2):456-492. doi:10.1016/j.cell.2015.09.029 (CITATION.md also asks for Ramaswamy et al. 2015, Front Neural Circuits 9:44, doi:10.3389/fncir.2015.00044; that DOI was not checked against Crossref)
model.license: MIT (OSB LICENSE; exception: NMC/parser/L* directories carry their own licence; candidate files are in NMC/NeuroML2)
model.expected_behavior: Single compartment, same geometry as hay2011_soma. Adds NaTs2_t 100 and KdShu2007 0.2 mS/cm2 (erev -100 mV); NaTa_t 200 instead of 300; otherwise the Hay densities (Ih 0.2, Ca_LVAst 3.43). Harness: -0.01 nA 100-200 ms, +0.05 nA 300-400 ms. Shipped NEURON reference used by the jNeuroML OMV test (NMC/NEURON/.test.mep): 5 spikes 307.3-392.6 ms, ISI 17.5 -> 23.6 ms (adapting). Not simulated in this sweep.
model.inclusion_reason: MIT; jNeuroML OMV test (check-runs at this commit: jNeuroML success). Adapting reference train. OSB-assembled test cell; uses the same channel files as hay2011_soma (BBP reuses the Hay channels), so the two form one family for splitting. The harness network includes Ca.channel.nml, which the cell does not use.
